quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a platform that lets a company fine-tune a leading AI model safely on its own private data.
quests.correctAnswer: Your own data trains the model inside a fully private environment, so you get frontier AI performance without a single file ever leaving your control.
quests.hint: Centre the pitch on the private data confidentiality assurance.
quests.explanation: Data confidentiality is the main barrier to enterprise AI adoption, and solving it is what actually unlocks the market.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a family app that helps parents agree, in advance, on realistic screen-time rules for a family holiday.
quests.correctAnswer: Rules are agreed calmly before the suitcases are even packed, so the holiday itself doesn't turn into the family's first real argument about screens.
quests.hint: Ground the answer in agreeing in advance, before tempers are involved.
quests.explanation: Solving a disagreement in advance, while everyone's calm, avoids the far harder conversation once everyone's already frustrated.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a system that checks an AI's answers for factual accuracy before they ever reach a business user.
quests.correctAnswer: Every answer is checked against the facts before a single word reaches an employee's screen, making enterprise AI reliable enough for decisions that actually matter.
quests.hint: Lead with reliability for high-stakes decisions.
quests.explanation: Reliability for genuinely high-stakes decisions is what separates a serious business tool from an interesting experiment.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a fleet platform that manages self-driving delivery vans for busy city freight routes.
quests.correctAnswer: Self-driving vans run city freight routes around the clock, with no driver shortage, no fatigue risk, and no shift that ever needs covering.
quests.hint: Open with the two advantages together: availability and safety.
quests.explanation: Combining constant availability with a genuine safety improvement gives operators two separate, compelling reasons to switch.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a subscription that helps grandparents send a short weekly video message to grandchildren who live far away.
quests.correctAnswer: One short video a week keeps a grandparent's voice and face part of a grandchild's life, even across a distance neither of them chose.
quests.hint: Start with staying present, not just staying in touch.
quests.explanation: Framing the product around genuinely staying present, not just messaging, gives it real emotional weight for both generations.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a drone inspection service checking bridges and power lines for damage instead of a manual crew.
quests.correctAnswer: A drone checks the bridge or power line that once required someone to physically climb it, replacing real danger with a faster, safer report.
quests.hint: Begin with the danger removed, not just the speed gained.
quests.explanation: Removing genuine physical danger from a job is a stronger case than speed alone, especially to safety officers.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a platform that manufactures certain medicines outside living cells, cutting production time from weeks to days.
quests.correctAnswer: The same medicine that once took weeks to grow can now be produced in days, outside a living cell entirely, so shortages close faster.
quests.hint: Anchor the pitch in the weeks-to-days production speed.
quests.explanation: A dramatic, specific time saving in medicine manufacturing has a direct, understandable effect on how fast shortages can end.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a shopping app that finds the exact size and fit of a specific shoe model across every retailer.
quests.correctAnswer: Enter the exact model, and it finds your true size at every retailer stocking it, ending the returns cycle that used shoe shopping to dread.
quests.hint: Centre the pitch on ending the shoe-return cycle, not just search.
quests.explanation: Naming a very specific, familiar frustration - the shoe-return cycle - makes a search tool feel genuinely useful.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a drug delivery technology that navigates directly to a specific cell before releasing its treatment.
quests.correctAnswer: A microscopic delivery vehicle travels straight to the exact cell that needs treatment, sparing the healthy tissue that older methods couldn't avoid.
quests.hint: Ground the answer in what's spared, not just what's targeted.
quests.explanation: Naming what's spared, healthy tissue, makes a precise, technical idea feel immediately meaningful to a patient.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a specialised computer chip that runs AI using far less power than a standard processor.
quests.correctAnswer: The same AI task runs on a fraction of the power, so a device can think for itself for days on a single charge, not hours.
quests.hint: Translate the technical spec into a real, everyday outcome.
quests.explanation: Turning a chip specification into something felt, like battery life, is what makes a technical breakthrough meaningful.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a family estate-organising service that helps siblings sort a parent's belongings with care, not just efficiency.
quests.correctAnswer: Every item is sorted with care, not haste, so grief and logistics don't have to be handled in the very same difficult afternoon.
quests.hint: Lead with emotional care, not just organisational efficiency.
quests.explanation: Acknowledging the emotional weight of a task, not just the practical side, is what makes this service feel trustworthy.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an autonomous agricultural vehicle that plants, sprays, and harvests with precision no human operator can consistently match.
quests.correctAnswer: Working around the clock in every season, these vehicles plant and harvest with a precision no tired human operator can consistently hold hour after hour.
quests.hint: Open with consistency over time, not just precision.
quests.explanation: Consistency over long hours, not just a single accurate moment, is what actually separates automation from manual skill here.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a travel concierge platform that plans an entire trip around one traveller's specific dietary restrictions.
quests.correctAnswer: Every meal, every restaurant, every day of the itinerary is planned around your exact dietary needs, so travel finally stops meaning constant vigilance.
quests.hint: Start with the relief of not having to stay constantly alert.
quests.explanation: Naming constant vigilance, not just the diet itself, speaks to the real, quiet exhaustion many travellers actually feel.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a bioprinting platform that grows small samples of human tissue for safer, more accurate drug testing.
quests.correctAnswer: New drugs are tested on real human tissue grown in a lab, catching a dangerous side effect long before it ever reaches a clinical trial.
quests.hint: Begin with catching danger earlier, not the printing process itself.
quests.explanation: Catching a risk earlier in the process is what actually makes a new lab technique matter to patient safety.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a workplace app that lets an employee flag, anonymously, exactly when a deadline is unrealistic before agreeing to it.
quests.correctAnswer: A quiet, anonymous flag raises an unrealistic deadline before it's agreed to, not three stressful weeks later when it's already too late to fix.
quests.hint: Anchor the pitch in the timing - before agreement, not after.
quests.explanation: Timing is everything here: a concern raised before agreement is genuinely useful, while one raised after rarely changes anything.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a digital twin platform that helps city planners test infrastructure changes before any construction begins.
quests.correctAnswer: A full digital copy of the city lets planners test a new road or bridge for years of impact, long before a single brick is laid.
quests.hint: Centre the pitch on testing years of impact before any real construction.
quests.explanation: Testing consequences years in advance, safely, is a genuinely powerful argument for any major public investment.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a subscription that helps new parents build a simple, realistic budget for a baby's first year.
quests.correctAnswer: Real costs from real first-year budgets replace vague online estimates, so new parents can plan with confidence instead of quiet financial anxiety.
quests.hint: Contrast real numbers with vague online guesses.
quests.explanation: Contrasting real numbers with vague guesses is what turns anxious planning into something a parent can actually trust.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a hallucination-detection layer that checks an AI's claims before they reach a customer-facing chat.
quests.correctAnswer: Every claim an AI makes is quietly checked before a customer ever sees it, so confidence in the answer never outpaces its actual accuracy.
quests.hint: Ground the answer in matching confidence to actual accuracy.
quests.explanation: Matching confidence to accuracy is exactly what earns trust in any AI tool used in front of real customers.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a subscription box that helps a family plan a genuinely tech-free weekend once a month.
quests.correctAnswer: One weekend a month arrives pre-planned and screen-free, so 'let's do something different' finally happens instead of staying just an idea.
quests.hint: Contrast the idea with the actual follow-through.
quests.explanation: Naming the gap between a good intention and actually following through is what makes this box feel necessary.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a synthetic biology platform that engineers microbes to produce industrial chemicals without the usual toxic process.
quests.correctAnswer: The same chemical is grown through fermentation instead of a toxic industrial process, cutting both emissions and the safety risk in the factory itself.
quests.hint: Lead with what's eliminated - toxicity and emissions together.
quests.explanation: Eliminating toxicity, not just emissions, gives this pitch both an environmental and a genuine workplace safety case.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a personal archive app that quietly backs up a family's photos, videos, and voice notes in one place.
quests.correctAnswer: Every photo, video, and voice note lives safely in one place, so a memory is never lost to a broken phone again.
quests.hint: Name the specific loss - a broken phone - this prevents.
quests.explanation: Naming a specific, believable disaster makes an ordinary backup app feel like real, necessary insurance.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a multimodal AI platform that processes documents, images, and audio together in a single unified workflow.
quests.correctAnswer: Documents, images, and audio are handled in one single workflow, ending the constant switching between separate tools that used to slow every team down.
quests.hint: Open with ending the tool-switching, not the technology itself.
quests.explanation: Naming the tool-switching problem directly is more persuasive than simply listing what the platform can technically do.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a service that helps adult children navigate a difficult conversation about an ageing parent's driving safety.
quests.correctAnswer: A structured, guided conversation replaces an awkward confrontation, helping a family talk about driving safety without it turning into a fight.
quests.hint: Contrast a guided conversation with an unplanned confrontation.
quests.explanation: Contrasting structure with confrontation shows exactly why guidance helps with a conversation families often keep avoiding.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an autonomous vehicle inspection service that checks bridges and tunnels for structural wear without closing traffic.
quests.correctAnswer: Inspections happen while traffic keeps flowing normally overhead, replacing costly road closures with a faster, equally thorough structural check.
quests.hint: Start with what stays open, not just what's inspected.
quests.explanation: Highlighting what stays open, not just the inspection itself, speaks directly to what city planners actually worry about.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a subscription that sends a themed, hands-on family science project to try together every month.
quests.correctAnswer: One real experiment a month brings the whole family to the kitchen table, curiosity included, no screen required for any of it.
quests.hint: Begin with the shared table moment, not the science itself.
quests.explanation: Selling the shared moment, not just the experiment, gives an educational box a genuine emotional pull for parents.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a company that recovers critical minerals from old batteries to build new ones, cutting reliance on newly mined material.
quests.correctAnswer: Instead of mining more raw material from the ground, this process recovers what's already inside a dead battery, meeting most of what a new one needs without a single new mine.
quests.hint: Anchor the pitch in what's avoided - new mining - not just recycling.
quests.explanation: Naming what's avoided, not just what's recovered, makes a technical recycling process feel like a genuine environmental win.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a workplace app that helps a manager prepare fairly and thoroughly for a difficult feedback conversation.
quests.correctAnswer: A short guided script helps a manager prepare for a hard conversation properly, so honesty and kindness don't have to be a trade-off.
quests.hint: Centre the pitch on kindness and honesty coexisting, not competing.
quests.explanation: Framing honesty and kindness as compatible, not opposed, is exactly what makes managers trust a difficult-conversation tool.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a non-invasive device that helps stroke patients regain motor control through guided daily practice at home.
quests.correctAnswer: Guided daily practice at home rebuilds motor control step by step, extending a clinic's rehabilitation programme into every single day of the week, not just appointment days.
quests.hint: Ground the answer in extending care beyond the clinic's own hours.
quests.explanation: Extending care beyond scheduled appointments is what actually accelerates recovery for most rehabilitation patients.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a travel app that automatically finds pet-friendly accommodation and nearby vet clinics for the whole trip.
quests.correctAnswer: Every hotel is pre-checked as pet-friendly, with the nearest vet already mapped, so travelling with a dog stops meaning a dozen separate phone calls.
quests.hint: Lead with the phone calls this removes, not the listings.
quests.explanation: Removing a dozen tedious phone calls is a concrete, relatable relief for any pet owner planning to travel.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a communication device that helps a non-verbal person express complex thoughts through guided symbol and word prediction.
quests.correctAnswer: Guided word prediction turns a slow, effortful process into a real conversation, giving someone who is non-verbal a genuinely faster way to be understood.
quests.hint: Open with being understood, not the technology mechanics.
quests.explanation: Leading with the human outcome, being understood, matters far more here than any description of the underlying technology.
